All other routes use the JSON limit, whatever their Content-Type. A single file or field can have a smaller limit. A request over the limit gets HTTP 413 with the code request_too_large. Media downloads · When a request gives a media URL, the gateway downloads it with these limits: Setting Value AZIZAM_MEDIA_FETCH_MAX_BYTES Largest download, in bytes. Default 268,435,456 (256 MiB). AZIZAM_MEDIA_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS Comma-separated exact host names or IP addresses that may resolve to private network addresses. No wildcards. Empty by default. Redirects At most three. Each one is checked again. Timeouts 10 seconds to resolve and connect, 30 seconds per read, 60 seconds in total. Encoding The server must send the media uncompressed. The allow list cannot open loopback, link-local or cloud metadata addresses. Monitoring · Variable Default Effect AZIZAM_GPU_BUDGET_PATH none Shell script that sets GPU memory budget variables. Without it, status shows no budgets. AZIZAM_VRAM_ESTIMATES_PATH <repo>/cache/vram_estimates.json Cache of memory estimates for workflows. AZIZAM_DRIFT_REPORT_PATH <repo>/cache/drift_status.json Workflow drift report. AZIZAM_IMAGE_CACHE_DIR <repo>/cache/images Folder measured for the image storage figure in status. AZIZAM_IMAGE_CACHE_DIR only changes what status measures. To change where creations are stored, set images.cache_dir in the configuration file. The default is cache/images under the gateway's working directory. An engine record can name a budget variable with vram_budget_key. Status compares the engine's memory use on the GPU where it uses the most memory with that budget. Memory on other GPUs shows as spillover. Transcription concurrency · backends.<engine>.chunking.global_concurrency applies per gateway process, despite its name. If you run more than one gateway process, each one allows that many uploads and reserves its own disk budget.

title: Error codes
summary: The gateway's error shapes, and the next step for each code.
text: Use the HTTP status and code in program logic. Show message to people. The gateway uses three error shapes, depending on the route. Error shapes · Browser routes. The routes that the browser interface uses, under /me/api, return a details.layer that says where the request stopped. See Troubleshooting. JSONCopy { "error": { "code": "not_authenticated", "message": "You're signed out. Sign in again.", "details": {"layer": "account"} } } Gateway API routes. The routes under /gateway/v1 return a code and a message: JSONCopy {"error": {"code": "media_job_not_found", "message": "media job 'job_123' not found"}} OpenAI-compatible routes, and gateway-wide refusals such as request_too_large and gateway_draining, use the OpenAI shape, with message, type, param and code. The Anthropic and Ollama routes use their own protocol's shape. See each page under Build with the API. Any route · Code Status Next step request_too_large 413 Make the request smaller. See request limits. gateway_draining 503 Wait for the Retry-After interval, then try again. resource_admission_denied 503 The engines are busy. Wait for the Retry-After interval, then try again. Media jobs API · Code Status Next step media_job_not_found 404 Check the job ID. Only your app's jobs are visible. media_job_not_ready 409 Wait until the job has succeeded, then read its content. unsupported_media_job 400 Use a supported intent. See Media jobs. invalid_media_job 400 Fix the request body. invalid_media_job_event_query 400 Pass after_sequence or after_id, not both. media_job_cancel_conflict 409 The job can no longer be canceled. Check its state. media_jobs_unavailable 503 Try again later. The tables below list the browser route codes, by layer. Account · Code Next step not_authenticated, session_user_not_found Sign in again. owner_required Choose your own work. source_not_allowed Choose one of your apps. make_disabled Ask the owner to let your account make things. too_many_jobs (HTTP 429) Wait for one of your jobs to finish. Library · Code Next step asset_not_found Choose another item in Library. asset_unavailable Check a copy you downloaded. prompt_not_accessible Download without the prompt. job_not_found Choose a job from your own list. job_finished Refresh to see the result. job_finishing Wait for the result to appear in Library. source_pending Wait for the source picture to finish. source_missing, source_not_found Choose another source picture. input_file_unavailable Send the input file again. Request · Code Next step invalid_cursor, invalid_limit, invalid_since Refresh the list. invalid_status, invalid_source, invalid_date Choose the filter again. invalid_metadata Choose Download again. unsupported_period Usage covers the current month only. Refresh the page. unsupported_intent, invalid_prompt_mode Refresh the page and try again. invalid_json, unsupported_field Refresh the page and try again. model_required Choose a model. prompt_required Enter a prompt. prompt_too_long Shorten the prompt to the limit in the message. invalid_n Choose a picture count in the stated range. edit_needs_source Choose a picture to edit. generate_takes_no_source Remove the source picture. one_source Send one source picture. idempotency_conflict Refresh before you submit again. input_not_accepted, input_set_by_gateway Remove the named input. Gateway · Code Next step make_unavailable Ask the owner to set up picture making. make_busy (HTTP 503, Retry-After: 60) Try again in a minute. make_queue_failed Try again. input_lost, restart_before_finish Make the item again. restart_while_canceling Make it again if you still want it. restart_while_running Check Library before you make it again. alias_misconfigured Ask the owner to check the model's settings. Engine, model and workflow · Code Layer Next step model_not_deployed engine Choose another model. no_picture model Try again. input_mapping_invalid workflow Ask the owner to check the named input's mapping. make_failed unknown Try again.

title: Glossary
summary: One name for each thing in Azizam, and what it means.
text: These docs use one name for each thing. Where the API uses another name, the entry says so. Access plan · In the API: profile. A named set of rules that decides which requests an app may make. See Access plans. Admin key · A key for changing the gateway's configuration. It cannot run model requests. Keep it out of apps. App · A client that uses the gateway, such as a chat app, a script or an agent. A personal app belongs to a person. A service app belongs to a service account. See Apps and keys. App key · A key that lets an app send requests. It is shown once, when it is created. Category · An owner-defined label in a policy that can add restrictions to access plans. See Categories. Creation · A picture, video or audio file made through the gateway. Creations are listed in Library. Engine · A server that does model work, such as chat, pictures or speech. You run it and connect it to the gateway. See Engines and models. Gateway · One running installation of Azizam. Job · Work that can take longer than one request, such as making a picture or a video. You can check a job and read its result later. See Media jobs. Member · A person invited to use a gateway. Model name · The name that apps use to choose a model. The owner maps it to an engine's own model ID. Owner · The person who runs the gateway. The owner creates the first account, connects engines and invites members. Provider · A remote service, usually paid, that the gateway can send requests to. See Providers and spend. Receipt · A record of what happened to one request. See Receipts and usage. Workflow · A named task that the owner sets up, such as making a video from a prompt. A workflow lists the inputs it needs.
